description: Mine radon (Rn-222) released by mine ventilation (underground) and open pits per tonne of uranium produced by conventional mining, 1950-1979 (extrapolated)
notes: Convention (METHODS 3.2, 4.1a, D24): value is for the HEAD nuclide of the group; the engine applies the group multiplier. UNSCEAR 2016 Table 5 gives 66 TBq/(GW a) for non-ISL mining at 220 t U/(GW a) (S0001), i.e. 3.0e11 Bq/t U. The 1993 value is 300 GBq/t (75 TBq/(GW a) at 250 t/(GW a), range 1-2,000 GBq/t, S0006 para 83) and the 1982/88 value is 70 TBq/(GW a) at about 150 t/(GW a) LWR (S0008 paras 27, 32; about 4.7e11 Bq/t). Centre 3.8e11 = geometric mean of 3.0e11 and 4.7e11 (earlier-era operations are not measured; open-pit and underground not separated). Low 1e11, high 1.5e12 (factor 4 either side, wider than the 1980-2025 row because nothing before 1982 is measured). Engine rule: apply to u_production x (1 - ISL share) x phi_civil. This is process radon from mine ventilation, NOT exhalation from waste rock or tailings (SCHEMA 3.2).

description: Mill tailings (impounded) activity of Th-230 per tonne of uranium produced by milling
notes: Convention (METHODS 3.2, 4.1a, D24): value is for the HEAD nuclide of the group; the engine applies the group multiplier. Mass balance per t U of product: ore activity = natural-U activity 1.2347e+10 Bq/t divided by recovery 0.95 (0.90-0.98; USGS 90-95 % extraction, S1000), times retention in tailings (secular equilibrium in the ore assumed). Acid-leach circuits dissolve 30-90 % of the Th (S1000), but the dissolved Th is precipitated into the tailings circuit on neutralisation; the product carries negligible Th. 0.95 (0.70-0.995) is a judgement (no mill balance for Th-230 found; G6). Enters the u_tailings residue (milling stage). ISL production has no tailings (the ISL ponds are a gap, G10).

description: Airborne release of U-238 from conversion, enrichment and fuel fabrication per GW a of nuclear electricity (UNSCEAR model facility)

Applied to the electricity of the country that burns the fuel, not where the plant stands (G11). Air values are not scaled for later eras (no trend data).

ENDF/B-VIII.0 cumulative thermal yields (S0141) for a fission mix {'U235': 0.65, 'Pu239': 0.31, 'Pu241': 0.01, 'U238': 0.03} (JUDGEMENT for this type; LWR mix from S0142), fissions 3.12e+19 per s per GW thermal, eta 0.3: discharged activity = Y x F x (1 - exp(-lambda T))/T per year with residence T = 5.5 y (about 5.5 y in core (Magnox about 5 GWd/t at about 2.5 MW/t; AGR about 27 GWd/t at about 12 MW/t; both ASSUMED, not sourced here)). Bounds: fission mix +-0.15 U-235/Pu-239 swap, T +-20 %, times 1.25. Fission products only: activation products and actinides for this reactor type are a GAP (G3, no inventory data). Driver nuc_gen_gcr.

description: Three Mile Island Unit 2 offsite release 28 March - 7 April 1979: Xe-133 (noble gases expressed as Xe-133)
notes: Convention (METHODS 3.2, 4.1a, D24): value is for the HEAD nuclide of the group; the engine applies the group multiplier. Event release (E002): central 2.5 MCi (Rogovin, S0138, not retrieved by Phase 1), low 1 MCi, high 40 MCi (NRC range, S0108); the NRC letter also quotes about 10 MCi from licensee consultants. Noble gases are almost all Xe-133 with some Kr-85, Xe-133m and Xe-135 (not separated: G12). JUDGEMENT as in events.csv.
